dw-dossier.name: Dossier
dw-dossier.changelog: 2.4.10 — Fixed, and serious: reverting a deployed schema recommendation on a site that runs Yoast, Rank Math or Squirrly permanently deleted the page the schema was on. A revert now removes the schema and leaves the page alone. Until a site has this version, do not revert a schema recommendation on a site that runs one of those three plugins. Eight things change on a site after this update. One: an MCP key writes only after a site administrator ticks Allow write tools under Settings, Advanced, MCP Server. A key that has already made a change keeps working; one that has only read stays read-only until the box is ticked. Two: schema from template rules is checked before it is printed. A part missing a required property is left out, a LocalBusiness with no street address prints as an Organization, and a document missing its own required property is not printed. Three: the example values a stock template ships with, the 4.8 rating from 127 reviews and the two example FAQ questions, are never printed by Dossier, and a deploy that holds them is refused. Schema handed to SEOPress, Rank Math, Yoast or Squirrly before this update is still printed by that plugin; the readiness report names it. Four: schema that Dossier stored through SEOPress Pro and that SEOPress Pro never printed starts printing. Five: where Dossier is the only SEO plugin, a page with no written description gets one made from its content, the blog and shop pages print their stored title, description, social tags, canonical and robots values, and a password-protected page no longer gets a social description taken from its content. Six: presence.w4 carries a version, a content hash, the time its content last changed, its source of truth and a freshness status. It is rebuilt when a source changes. Seven, on a shop: presence.w4 lists only published products that are visible in the catalog, have no password and are not set to noindex, at the stored catalog price in the shop's base currency. On a Polylang or WPML shop it lists default-language products only. A shop's file can list fewer products and different prices after the update. Eight: a site set to stay out of search engines, by Discourage search engines in WordPress or Dossier's whole-site noindex, stops publishing presence.w4. Two things to do by hand. Older versions stored title templates that hold %%date%%, %%category%%, %%canonical%% or %%excerpt%% broken: check the title templates under Settings and save them once. Export files made by older versions hold the site's keys: delete them, and change the keys if a file left your hands. Also in this version: The business profile is not written by an AI provider unless a site admin asks for it. The Schema Audit on the SEO Arsenal page now runs and counts. New agent tool populate fills the wp-admin pages after a setup run, and writes Knowledge Graph values only after the site admin's yes and only into empty fields. Auto-detect no longer picks Squirrly from a leftover database table, which made a site print default titles. New agent tools for moving off another SEO plugin; no tool turns a plugin on or off. presence.w4 describes variable products and follows scheduled sales. Saving Settings no longer resets a Knowledge Graph type such as Dentist to Organization, re-stamps the business profile or empties its competitor list. Fixed: the agent import tool in replace mode replaced every setting, which dropped title templates, noindex rules and the write switch. Fixed: the wp-admin export held the site's keys, and an import could set agent access, robots rules and the whole-site noindex; exports hold no keys now and an import leaves those settings alone. Where Dossier is the only SEO plugin, a homepage that lists the latest posts prints WebSite and Organization schema. On multisite, or with DISALLOW_UNFILTERED_HTML set, only a network administrator can change the Custom Tracking Code fields; stored code keeps printing. The full list is in CHANGELOG.md.
